items.title: Members of Parliament
items.description: Met with Members of Parliament from a range of countries to brief them on the human rights situation facing Eelam Tamils.

items.title: UN Human Rights Council, Geneva
items.description: Advocated in Geneva with the OHCHR and diplomatic missions ahead of Human Rights Council sessions to advance accountability and justice.

items.title: European Union
items.description: Met with EU officials and members of the European Parliament to advocate for the withdrawal of GSP+ trade privileges from Sri Lanka and for an international inquiry into the genocide.

items.title: Government Officials
items.description: Maintained continued engagement with government officials internationally to brief them on the current human rights situation in Tamileelam.

items.title: Research-Based Reports
items.description: Provided research documents on pressing issues to policymakers and politicians to shed light on the accountability and justice process.
